name: Lessons Anew
summary: At Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids to Moonglade to learn how to cleanse natural and unnatural poisons. The sacred haven is where apprentices begin mastering that art under Dendrite Starblaze, a night elf druid, as real poisonings demand more than practice.

sections.title: The Gift of Cenarius
sections.body: Cenarius gave druids the power to purge virulent toxins with an incantation, and their charge is to protect the wilds. Turak Runetotem teaches that such magic needs a firm grounding. Before a druid uses it to clear a blight, they must understand venom’s physical toll and learn to treat it by ordinary means.

sections.title: Summons to Nighthaven
sections.body: Turak sends promising acolytes north from Mulgore along sacred pathways to Moonglade. In its peaceful village of Nighthaven, ancient night elf mentors such as Dendrite Starblaze teach elf and tauren practitioners alike. Their shared study reflects the Cenarion Circle’s delicate truce, which rises above the political strife between Horde and Alliance.

sections.title: A Real Crisis in the Barrens
sections.body: Near the Crossroads in the Barrens, uncontrolled poisonings are spreading among the animals. Dendrite Starblaze has no time for a practice exercise: a plea for aid has come from the Crossroads. The request turns a rite of passage into urgent fieldwork, where young druids must face the suffering of wild beasts.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem, the tauren druid trainer, offers the rite on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He calls on initiates who have shown an early commitment to the Cenarion teachings.

aliases: who is the night elf in moonglade
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze is an elder night elf druid who lives in Nighthaven, Moonglade. Despite tensions between night elves and tauren, he teaches young druids of both races the traditions of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: What power is this quest teaching me?
faq.answer: Your instruction begins with Cure Poison. The lessons cover venom’s physical and magical nature and teach druids to purge harmful afflictions from allies and wild creatures in their care.

faq.q: Why does a tauren have to study under a night elf?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is a neutral brotherhood dedicated to the balance of nature. Night elves first formalized modern druidism under Cenarius, then welcomed the tauren back into the order and shared sacred places such as Moonglade despite the faction war.

faq.q: What is happening at the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Wildlife around the Crossroads in the Barrens is suffering an aggressive wave of poisonings that local handlers cannot contain. Dendrite Starblaze turns your training toward the field, where you are to find the source and make a remedy.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to get to Moonglade for this quest?
faq.answer: As a druid, you have the innate spell Teleport: Moonglade, which takes you straight to Nighthaven. It avoids the need to travel on foot through treacherous contested lands.

angles.text: As a druid, you move from basic shapeshifting and skirmishing toward stewardship of the wilds. Your path now begins with learning Cure Poison.
As a tauren, your pilgrimage shows how deeply the Earth Mother's children have reconnected with Cenarius's teachings alongside their night elf peers.
As a member of the Horde, you can find safe harbor in Moonglade under the Cenarion Circle's sacred protection, even while Horde warriors clash with night elves in Ashenvale.
